parameters.axes: x east along street, y north along street, z up
parameters.illustrated_height_crosscheck: DCA design section 08, 236 pixels per illustrated 10m: old street wall/roof about18–19.3m, strong cornice14–15m, upper edge about20m. New roof pavilions at23.5–25m are excluded. Not a survey.

historical_model_scope: North/east/eastern-south historic street wings. Three independently modeled concave corners; simple court. Artificial cuts are plain closures, not claimed historical elevations.
source_identity: Current macro14-13720-6694 local1554 includes modern west/southwest L, so full-source replacement is prohibited.

modeled_corner_types.NE: Concave four-level wall, folded open columned porch, small first-floor half-oval glazed oriel with open balustrade.
modeled_corner_types.SE: Concave wall with a true unglazed ground arched passage into the court, no NE porch/oriel. Plain side/ceiling closures and outlet section are author estimates.
modeled_corner_types.NW: Concave wall with small ground doorway, tall two-storey arch and paired Ionic columns; no NE oriel.

exclusions: separate courtyard buildings and relocated red building
